title: theory-relative-ideal
description: The valuation v^R_{T,infinity} := iota*(v^T_infinity) obtained by reindexing a host theory's fully-settled state along a faithful type embedding iota of the resource's predicate scope into the theory's; it is a settling over the resource scope C^R recording what the theory says a resource at that scope should know, and is the standard against which a current resource state is measured.

hostTheorySettledState.description: v^T_infinity, the Cl^T-fixed-point of the host theory's own settling over its full predicate scope C^T

typeEmbedding.description: iota : C^R -> C^T, a faithful generator-class-preserving embedding placing the resource's predicate scope inside the theory's

resourceScope.description: C^R, the resource's predicate scope; the resulting settling is indexed over exactly this scope

isTheoryRelativeIdeal.description: for every p in C^R, (iota*(v^T_infinity))(p) = v^T_infinity(iota(p)): the pointwise restriction of the theory's settled state to the resource's predicates

notSelfClosure.description: v^R_{T,infinity} is NOT Cl^R applied to v^R; the host theory may derive content about the resource that the resource's own closure cannot, so the ideal may strictly exceed Cl^R's output
